source.name: OpenStreetMap
source.categoryBasis: OSM tags with conservative name checks and balanced category selection
notes: Public urban destinations, not boarding points verified by SCT.
Area coordinates are bounding-box centers, not verified entrances.
OSM modification dates do not certify current operation, opening hours, medical services or accessibility.
No private addresses, contact details or mapper identities included. Names of public institutions may commemorate people.
Nearest L1 point distance is straight-line distance to a community-mapped point, not a walking route or confirmed bus service.
Catalog covers the stated urban bbox and a selected subset of named places, not the whole municipality.
